correctness.rationale: Conjugate the invariant diffusion generator f''−n(x−P_ax)f' to Schrödinger form with confining quadratic exterior: compact resolvent and 1D Sturm simplicity. Exterior scaled eigenfunction e^(z²/4)D_ν(z) has logarithmic derivative R(ν)=ν Γ((1−ν)/2)/(√2 Γ(1−ν/2)) at zero; parity matching gives ak+atan(√n R(k²/n)/k)=jπ/2 for fixed j and large n. The small-ν gamma quotient R=β ν(1+ν log2+O(ν²)) and arctan expansion yield θ=βk n^-1/2+d k³ n^-3/2+O(n^-5/2), d=β(log2−π/6)>0, hence λ_j=κ_j²/A_n²−2dκ_j⁴/(A_n⁵ n^3/2)+O_{a,j}(n^-5/2). Sturm nodal count identifies j and rules out extra exterior zeros for ν<1. Independent 24 mpmath root/gamma tests checked the coefficient, several a,j,n and phase; not evidence of uniform-in-j expansion.
